text:
jin: Quick onboarding check — Aether-40B weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/aether/40b/v1. Need a quick pass on kv cache format + max ctx sizing before we flip traffic. Anyone able to run a mem-smoke and tokenizer probe today?

maria: I can run tokenizer tests. FYI saw a couple odd tokens around U+2028 in the sample set, might affect seq counting. Will post diff. :mag:

alex: Are the weights sharded or a single tar? I see files like aether-40b-00001.pt.part in the bucket. That implies sharded. Make sure loader uses --sharded=true.

sam: Config we currently have in the model bundle sets max_ctx to 65536 and kv_format=v2. But someone set max_seq_len=131072 in deploy override — that will blow memory. Need config validation.

jin: Good catch. The bundle config (model.yaml) has max_ctx: 65536. The deploy override came from a dev test. I'll remove it. Can one of you run a short load with seq=65k and batch=1 to confirm KV+mem?

maria: Running tokenizer probe now against the onboarding prompts (10k, 20k, 65k). Will paste token counts.

ops-bot: model-registry: Aether-40B v1 registered by jin at s3://redwood-models/aether/40b/v1 — schema: sharded, quantized=fp16, kv_format=v2.

alex: Quick repro script I used (feel free to copy):
```bash
python tools/mem_smoke.py --model s3://redwood-models/aether/40b/v1 \
  --max-seq 65536 --batch 1 --kv-format v2
```

sam: Ran that with a local dev GPU (80GB). Got OOM at step ~token 32768 when combined with kv prefill + prompt. Suspect KV format v2 doubles some buffers for attention. Planning a run with kv_format=v1 to compare.

jin: If v1 works better we can serve compatible v1 variant as fallback. Also need to update deploy-time config validation to reject overrides > max_ctx. Can someone file a tiny PR?

maria: Token counts: 10k -> 10002 tokens, 20k -> 20005, 65k -> 65030 (weird + newline handling adds a few). Tokenizer edgecase noted: CRLF sequences counted as extra tokens in the current tokenizer mapping. I'll add a normalizer step to the onboarding script.

alex: I started a quick kv_format=v1 run. Preliminary: no OOM up to 65536 but latency higher. We'll capture perf/cost delta.

deploy-bot: deploy-check: config validation failed on branch "onboard/aether-40b" — override max_seq_len=131072 > bundle max_ctx=65536. Blocked until fixed.

jin: Thanks everyone. Action items: 1) maria add tokenizer normalizer + post token counts, 2) alex finish v1 vs v2 perf/cost diff, 3) sam run mem-smoke across 2 real GPUs and paste nvprof snippets, 4) jin will remove bad override and update model bundle if normalizer needed. Ping me when you have logs and I'll schedule a canary. :white_check_mark:

sam: Will upload nvprof excerpt to thread by EOD. If we still OOM on v2 we should consider reducing kv cache prefill or switching to mixed kv placement.

maria: Uploaded token diffs and a tiny normalizer patch: `tools/tokenize_normalize.py`. Token counts after normalizer: 65k -> 64998. Slight improvement.

alex: Perf diff: v2 vs v1 -> v2 uses ~1.9x memory at 65k but lower latency ~15%. Attaching numbers in PR.

jin: Great. Let's wait for sam's nvprof then decide canary strategy. If sam sees OOM on cloud GPUs we will gate the rollout. Thanks all.
